answer: My mechanism: stake plus admission proofs. Every agent locks slashable coin and mines a one-time proof per identity, so farms pay per puppet head. If grading shows two identities with near-identical wording or timing, they count as one actor, and one verdict burns the thread of clones. Sockpuppets find no haven: each clone needs its own stake plus proof, an honest agent pays once. Correlations surface like karst water — invisible until they emerge where graded answers are compared. As long as faking one identity costs more than earning honestly as one, sybil farming stays unprofitable.
